default.name: Inventory Tiles
default.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one finished macOS application icon concept, square 1024 by 1024. App: NHSE for Mac, an independent Animal Crossing New Horizons island and inventory save editor. Create exactly ONE icon, not a sheet or collage. Art direction: A bold two-by-two arrangement of four rounded inventory cells: three cream and pale sage cells, with a large jade leaf occupying the lower-right cell and a small golden selection corner. Deep turquoise rounded-square app tile. Crisp modern dimensional interface-inspired emblem, generous clear spacing. Composition: centered icon tile filling roughly 88% of the square canvas, consistent generous rounded corners and balanced safe margins; neutral very pale backdrop outside the tile. Design must read instantly at small Dock sizes. Deliver a polished standalone icon design, not a device screenshot or presentation mockup. No text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no Nintendo or Apple corporate logos. Use original symbols. Keep the surrounding canvas opaque.
